dialogue.intro: Grab some wood and make a crafting table. Food and a few tools are probably a good idea after that.
dialogue.progress: Make a crafting table from wooden planks.
dialogue.complete: Crafting table sorted. Time for some tools.

dialogue.intro: You'll need a stone pickaxe before you can mine iron. Might as well make one now.
dialogue.progress: Craft a stone pickaxe with cobblestone and sticks.
dialogue.complete: That should last a bit longer than the wooden one.

dialogue.intro: Stone tools have their limits. Make an iron pickaxe before you go looking for diamonds.
dialogue.progress: Craft an iron pickaxe.
dialogue.complete: Ready for diamonds. Just watch what you're standing on when you mine them.

dialogue.intro: If you're heading into caves, bring some armor. Iron will do the job.
dialogue.progress: Make or find a piece of iron armor.
dialogue.complete: A bit more room for mistakes. Still worth bringing a shield.

dialogue.intro: Lava works as furnace fuel, and a bucket of it might come in handy for a portal too.
dialogue.progress: Fill a bucket with lava.
dialogue.complete: Keep that away from anything wooden.

dialogue.intro: Skeletons get a lot less annoying once you've got a shield. Try blocking an arrow.
dialogue.progress: Raise your shield to block an arrow.
dialogue.complete: Much better than taking it in the face.

dialogue.intro: Water over a lava source makes obsidian. You'll need a diamond pickaxe to collect it.
dialogue.progress: Collect a block of obsidian.
dialogue.complete: Hang onto it. You'll need more for a portal, or a couple of blocks for an enchanting table.

dialogue.intro: Keep an eye out while you're mining. Bring an iron pickaxe or better so you can actually collect the diamonds.
dialogue.progress: Mine diamond ore and collect a diamond.
dialogue.complete: Check around the ore for lava before you mine the rest.

dialogue.intro: Get an obsidian portal built, then light it. Bring food, spare blocks and a flint and steel.
dialogue.progress: Step through a Nether portal.
dialogue.complete: Worth writing down where the portal is before you wander off.

dialogue.intro: If you've got enough diamonds left over, some better armor would help.
dialogue.progress: Make or find a piece of diamond armor.
dialogue.complete: A decent upgrade. Enchanting it would make it even better.

dialogue.intro: Got an enchanting table set up? Try it on a tool or a piece of armor. You'll need some lapis and levels.
dialogue.progress: Enchant an item at an enchanting table.
dialogue.complete: Check what you got before you start spending the rest of your levels.

dialogue.intro: Found a zombie villager? Get it somewhere safe, give it Weakness, then use a golden apple.
dialogue.progress: Cure a zombie villager.
dialogue.complete: That worked. Keep them somewhere safe while you figure out what to build for them.

dialogue.intro: Throw an Eye of Ender and follow where it goes. Bring a few spares; they don't always survive the trip.
dialogue.progress: Follow Eyes of Ender to a stronghold.
dialogue.complete: Have a look around. You can get supplies sorted before using the portal.

dialogue.intro: Get your food, gear and blocks sorted before you jump through the portal.
dialogue.progress: Enter the End through a stronghold portal.
dialogue.complete: Check your footing first. Then deal with the dragon.

dialogue.intro: Bring food and some spare blocks. Leave yourself a way to find the portal again.
dialogue.progress: Enter the Nether.
dialogue.complete: Have a look around, but keep track of how you're getting back.

dialogue.intro: You'll need to look around the Nether for a fortress. Bring enough blocks to get across the awkward bits.
dialogue.progress: Find a Nether fortress.
dialogue.complete: Bring back some blaze rods and nether wart while you're here.

dialogue.intro: Find some blazes in a fortress. Leave yourself somewhere to hide between shots.
dialogue.progress: Defeat a blaze and collect a blaze rod.
dialogue.complete: Save a rod for a brewing stand. You'll want blaze powder for brewing and Eyes of Ender too.

dialogue.intro: Set up a brewing stand and try making a potion. Fire Resistance is a pretty useful one for Nether trips.
dialogue.progress: Brew a potion in a brewing stand.
dialogue.complete: Take a couple with you. No point leaving them all in a chest.

dialogue.intro: Get your gear sorted before going through. Bring blocks in case the platform is awkward.
dialogue.progress: Enter the End.
dialogue.complete: Keep an eye on the edge, and try not to stare at the endermen.

dialogue.intro: Take out the Ender Dragon. Food, blocks and a bow will help.
dialogue.progress: Defeat the Ender Dragon.
dialogue.complete: Dragon dealt with. Grab the experience, and take a breather if you need one.

dialogue.intro: A small farm saves you having to hunt for food every time you head out. Plant a few seeds near water.
dialogue.progress: Till some soil near water and plant a seed.
dialogue.complete: Let that grow while you're doing something else. Plant more when you've got spare seeds.
